correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT A1.user_id AS id FROM ActivityLog AS A1 JOIN ActivityLog AS A2 ON (A1.log_date = A2.log_date OR (A1.log_date IS NULL AND A2.log_date IS NULL)) AND A1.user_id = A2.user_id AND A1.item_id <> A2.item_id ORDER BY 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Rewrites self-join inequality on nullable item_id into two-stage GROUP BY with COUNT(user_id) > 1, erroneously counting a NULL item_id group as a distinct item.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH G1 AS (SELECT user_id, log_date, item_id, COUNT(user_id) AS c1 FROM ActivityLog GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), G2 AS (SELECT user_id, log_date, COUNT(user_id) AS c2 FROM G1 GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS id FROM G2 WHERE c2 > 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
